tool_args.rationale: The pilot signatures match the archived spatiotemporal siphon-memory mechanism, whose five parameters are underidentified by the five pilot rows. The trajectory batch provides the additional observations needed to fit and distinguish the coupled dynamics.

considered_alternatives.option: Five-parameter spatiotemporal siphon-memory ODE fitted to pilot alone
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five observations cannot reliably identify five coupled parameters; the archive specifies at least eight rows.

considered_alternatives.option: Static siphon or uncoupled memory models
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The observed sink-gradient and coupled-transient signatures favor the combined mechanism, but the pilot does not adequately distinguish it.
It does not resolve the relevant mechanism or parameter ambiguity.
